payload.name: style
payload.type: StudioStyle built by newStyle(template, brief): id (client uid), name '<template> remix', status 'draft', base, theme, scenes {}, art [], made, tags, still 'fade', fallback, poster {frame:'cover'}, from {id,name,handle,house}, brief?, at

actions.note: From a template card; on success navigates to /app/creator/studio/<id> (the id from the response). The client mints the id today.

actions.name: withdrawStyle
actions.note: Only non-live; review and level removed, style returns to drafts; the used review is not returned.

actions.name: setPlan
actions.note: Creator after PaySheet (7500/month): credits += 10, reviewsLeft = max(reviewsLeft,2). Open: reviewsLeft = min(reviewsLeft,1). Open is selectable without payment.

actions.name: setSigned
actions.note: On after PaySheet (5000/month); off is free.

actions.name: draftStyle
actions.note: Costs COST.draft=4 credits. Failure reasons the UI handles: offline, no-credits (via why()), others. Success path picks HOUSE template whose base == data.base then saveDraft with theme = data.theme.

special.polling: none; data reloads on the studio-api change event (local storage event), plus ?sent query param shows 'Sent for review.' toast once and is stripped
special.note: Money shown as naira text built from numbers (naira()), amounts held as whole-naira numbers: 7500, 3000, 5000, 2500, 14880 earnings. Live previews of styles are client-rendered from the style spec; no server rendering needed. Pay flow goes through PaySheet (not in scope).

uiStatesHandled.note: all three resolve from synchronous localStorage promises; on first paint null; no skeleton. With a server these will be genuinely pending, so the designed skeleton is needed.
always entered when Draft it is pressed with text; the only reachable outcome of draft
coded but unreachable: draftStyle always returns offline (STUB)

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: any api result !ok other than offline: say(why(r)): no-credits, no-reviews, plan, not-found, failed ('This device is out of room')
uiStatesHandled.note: only 'failed' (storage full) and not-found are reachable locally; there is no page-level error state or retry; the page cannot show an error instead of content
no local path creates live; only fixtures
